q: The show’s stage design features bojagi, traditional Korean patchwork. The audience members are also presented with Korean traditional dance, including buchaechum, or “fan dance,” performed by a group of female dancers using fans painted in different colors.
2013 July 18, Claire Lee, “Popular TV drama revisited onstage”, in The Korea Herald:

e: From Latin Boiī + -ite, coined in 1898 by E. Weinschenk.
